name: News Arcade
description: RSS headlines in the NBA / NFL / NHL Live arcade style: one story at a time with a feed logo tile, gradient headline row that crawls once so it is always read in full, age and summary, a segmented timer bar, and a BREAKING burst when a feed publishes a new top story. Feeds are shown round-robin; a failing feed keeps its last headlines. Replaces the news ticker.
author: ant456

versions.notes: First release: arcade headline screens, single-pass crawl, BREAKING burst, round-robin feeds, feed logos.
